info.title: LinkedIn Profile API: All Sections and Verified Work Emails, No Login
info.description:
Extract public LinkedIn profiles as JSON: work history, education, skills, posts, and optional MX-verified public emails. No login, zero charge on 403s.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/linkedin-profile (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Scrape public LinkedIn profiles without login, cookies or API key: name, headline, location, followers, connections, current company, jobs with dates, education, skills, about, articles, recent posts and similar profiles. Up to 5 results per request, as JSON.

profileUrls.title: Profile links or usernames
profileUrls.description: Profile links (https://www.linkedin.com/in/<name>, any country subdomain) or bare identifiers such as satyanadella. A request returns 5 profiles at most.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum profiles
maxProfiles.description: Stops after this many profiles have been read. A request returns 5 rows at most.

includeEmail.title: Extract & MX-verify public emails
includeEmail.description: Scan each profile public text and linked websites for published email addresses and verify their domain MX records via DNS-over-HTTPS. Never guesses unverified patterns; adds email, emails, and emailVerification fields.

200.description: JSON array of public LinkedIn profile objects

400.description: Missing or invalid profileUrls in request body (not billed)

404.description: No requested LinkedIn profile was found or public (not billed)
